status_summary: USPTO rescinded its June 2022 interim memorandum on discretionary denials on 2025-02-28, began an interim process splitting discretionary and merits institution decisions on 2025-03-26, and under a Director memorandum of 2025-10-17 has had the Director decide institution of all inter partes and post-grant reviews from 2025-10-20, usually by summary notice. It proposed rules on 2025-10-17 that would limit inter partes review where claims were previously upheld or parallel proceedings are likely to decide validity first; no final rule appears in the Federal Register. On processing speed, the Office reported on 2026-04-10 a backlog of 776,995 unexamined applications, down from a January 2025 peak of 837,928, and on 2026-05-06 extended its fast-track appeals pilot to 2028-05-06 with a four-month decision target against average appeal pendency of about 8.5 months. Whether these changes are balanced is disputed and is not assessed here.

timeline.event: USPTO rescinds its 2022 interim procedure memorandum on discretionary denials in AIA proceedings with parallel litigation.
USPTO begins an interim process splitting institution decisions into discretionary and merits tracks, with Director decisions on discretionary issues.
USPTO publishes proposed rules limiting inter partes review for previously challenged claims or where other proceedings will likely decide validity first.
The USPTO Director issues a memorandum under which the Director decides institution of all IPR and PGR proceedings, effective 2025-10-20.
USPTO reports 776,995 unexamined patent applications as of 2026-04-06, down from a peak of 837,928 in January 2025.
USPTO extends and modifies the fast-track appeals pilot to 2028-05-06 with a four-month decision target; average appeal pendency is reported at about 8.5 months.

title: Take a balanced approach to the PTAB and speed up application and appeal processing
uncertainties: A companion proposed rule of 2025-10-17 on briefing discretionary denial issues and a 2025-11-07 comment-extension notice were seen in a Federal Register listing but not opened; a Federal Register query of USPTO PTAB documents since 2025-01-20 showed no final rule. Application pendency figures were not in the backlog release. The 2026-04-10 backlog figure is a reported statistic, not an agency rule. Director institution by summary notice can be read as less transparent, which cuts against the text's call for transparent processing. Court challenges to the Director's institution practice were not reviewed.
